Read GENCODE ORFs
```{r}
# add this line to your config block
gencode_gtf <- "gencode.v43.annotation.gff3.gz" 

# --- (a) exons dos 17 ENSTs, do GFF3 v38 local ------------------------------
get_isoform_exons <- function(gff_path, ensts) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(gff_path))
  message("  lendo exons do GFF3: ", basename(gff_path))
  g  <- rtracklayer::import(gff_path)
  ex <- g[g$type == "exon"]
  if (length(ex) == 0) stop("nenhum exon no GFF")
  ex$enst_base <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", ex$transcript_id)
  want <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", ensts)
  ex <- ex[ex$enst_base %in% want]
  if (length(ex) == 0) stop("nenhum dos 17 ENSTs achado no GFF")
  split(ex, ex$enst_base)
}

# --- (b) blocos de exon dos ORFs, expandidos do BED12 -----------------------
# BED12: X1 chrom, X2 start(0-based), X3 end, X4 name, X5 score, X6 strand,
#   X7 thickStart, X8 thickEnd, X9 rgb, X10 blockCount,
#   X11 blockSizes(csv), X12 blockStarts(csv, relativo a X2)
read_orf_blocks <- function(path) {
  if (is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    message("  [skip] nao encontrado: ", path); return(NULL)
  }
  message("  lendo ORF BED12: ", basename(path))
  b <- readr::read_tsv(path, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE,
                       col_types = cols(.default = "c"), comment = "#")

  chrom  <- b$X1
  start0 <- as.numeric(b$X2)
  strand <- b$X6
  name   <- b$X4
  bcount <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(b$X10))
  bsizes <- b$X11
  bstarts<- b$X12

  nm_parts <- str_split(name, ":")
  orf_id   <- map_chr(nm_parts, ~ .x[1] %||% NA_character_)
  orf_type <- map_chr(nm_parts, ~ if (length(.x) >= 3) tail(.x, 1) else NA_character_)

  gr_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(b)), function(i) {
    nb <- bcount[i]
    if (is.na(nb) || nb < 1) {
      sizes  <- as.numeric(b$X3[i]) - start0[i]
      starts <- 0
    } else {
      sizes  <- as.numeric(str_split(bsizes[i], ",")[[1]] %>% .[. != ""])
      starts <- as.numeric(str_split(bstarts[i], ",")[[1]] %>% .[. != ""])
    }
    GRanges(seqnames = chrom[i],
            ranges  = IRanges(start = start0[i] + starts + 1, width = sizes),
            strand  = strand[i],
            orf_row = i, orf_id = orf_id[i],
            orf_type = orf_type[i], source = basename(path))
  })
  do.call(c, gr_list)
}
```

overlap exon blocks
```{r}
iso_exons  <- get_isoform_exons(gencode_gtf, lnc17$enst)

orf_list <- map(gencode_bed_files, read_orf_blocks) %>% discard(is.null)
stopifnot(length(orf_list) > 0)
orf_blocks <- Reduce(c, unname(orf_list))
stopifnot(is(orf_blocks, "GRanges"))
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(orf_blocks) <- "UCSC"

hit_rows <- map_dfr(names(iso_exons), function(eb) {
  ex <- iso_exons[[eb]]
  GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(ex) <- "UCSC"

  # número do exon como aparece no GFF3 (fallback pro índice ao longo do transcrito)
  exn <- ex$exon_number
  if (is.null(exn)) exn <- as.character(seq_along(ex))
  exid <- ex$exon_id %||% rep(NA_character_, length(ex))

  ov <- findOverlaps(orf_blocks, ex, ignore.strand = FALSE)
  if (length(ov) == 0) return(NULL)

  qi <- queryHits(ov); si <- subjectHits(ov)
  tibble(
    enst_base   = eb,
    orf_id      = orf_blocks$orf_id[qi],
    orf_type    = orf_blocks$orf_type[qi],
    source      = orf_blocks$source[qi],
    exon_number = exn[si],
    exon_id     = exid[si]
  ) %>% distinct()
})

# uma linha por (lncRNA, ORF), colapsando os exons que aquele ORF toca
gencode_hits <- hit_rows %>%
  group_by(enst_base, orf_id, orf_type, source) %>%
  summarise(exons = paste(sort(unique(as.integer(exon_number))), collapse = ","),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(lnc17 %>% select(lncrna, enst, enst_base), by = "enst_base") %>%
  mutate(match_level = "isoform_exon_overlap")
```

Summary
```{r}
orf_summary <- lnc17 %>% dplyr::select(lncrna, enst, ensg) %>%
  left_join(
    if (nrow(gencode_hits) > 0)
      gencode_hits %>% group_by(lncrna) %>%
        summarise(gencode_orf_n = n(),
                  gencode_orf_types = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(orf_type))),
                                            collapse = ";"),
                  gencode_exons = paste(sort(unique(as.integer(
                                    unlist(str_split(exons, ","))))),
                                    collapse = ","),
                  gencode_sources = paste(sort(unique(source)), collapse = ";"),
                  .groups = "drop")
    else tibble(lncrna = character(), gencode_orf_n = integer(),
                gencode_orf_types = character(), gencode_exons = character(),
                gencode_sources = character()),
    by = "lncrna") %>%
  mutate(gencode_orf_n = coalesce(gencode_orf_n, 0L),
         has_translated_orf = gencode_orf_n > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(has_translated_orf), lncrna)

write_csv(orf_summary, file.path(out_dir, "A1_orf_riboseq_summary.csv"))
saveRDS(list(summary = orf_summary, gencode_hits = gencode_hits),
        file.path(out_dir, "A1_orf_riboseq.rds"))

cat("\n===============  ORF / Ribo-seq evidence (17 lncRNAs)  ===============\n")
print(orf_summary, n = 30, width = Inf)
cat("\nlncRNAs com >=1 ORF catalogado (nesta isoforma): ",
    sum(orf_summary$has_translated_orf), " / 17\n", sep = "")
```

Sequences of my lncRNAs
```{r}
stopifnot(file.exists(tx_fasta))
fa  <- readDNAStringSet(tx_fasta)
hdr <- tibble(header = names(fa)) %>%
  mutate(enst      = str_extract(header, "ENST[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*"),
         enst_base = str_remove(enst, "\\.\\d+$"))

seq_tbl <- lnc17 %>%
  left_join(hdr %>% mutate(idx = row_number()), by = "enst_base") %>%
  filter(!is.na(idx))

missing_seq <- setdiff(lnc17$lncrna, seq_tbl$lncrna)
if (length(missing_seq) > 0)
  message("  sem sequencia no FASTA: ", paste(missing_seq, collapse = ", "))

# DNAStringSet nomeado por lncRNA, na ordem de lnc17
seq_set <- fa[seq_tbl$idx]
names(seq_set) <- seq_tbl$lncrna
```

scan isoform
```{r}
# conta sítios (7mer-m8) de cada miRNA do painel na sequência madura.
# Reporta: total de sítios, nº de miRNAs distintos com >=1 sítio, densidade/kb.
mre_scan <- map_dfr(names(seq_set), function(nm) {
  s   <- as.character(seq_set[[nm]])
  len <- nchar(s)
  per_mir <- map_int(mirna_panel$site7, ~ str_count(s, fixed(.x)))
  tibble(
    lncrna = nm,
    tx_len = len,
    mre_sites_total = sum(per_mir),
    mre_mirnas_with_site = sum(per_mir > 0),
    mre_density_per_kb = round(1000 * sum(per_mir) / len, 2)
  )
})

# detalhe por miRNA (pra tabela suplementar / inspeção)
mre_detail <- map_dfr(names(seq_set), function(nm) {
  s <- as.character(seq_set[[nm]])
  tibble(lncrna = nm,
         mirna = mirna_panel$mirna,
         site7 = mirna_panel$site7,
         n_sites = map_int(mirna_panel$site7, ~ str_count(s, fixed(.x)))) %>%
    filter(n_sites > 0)
})
```

Encori
```{r}
encori_fetch <- function(gene_symbol) {
  if (!use_encori_api) {
    f <- file.path(encori_flatdir, paste0(gene_symbol, ".txt"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
    return(readr::read_tsv(f, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE))
  }
  q <- list(assembly = "hg38", geneType = "lncRNA", miRNA = "all",
            clipExpNum = 1, degraExpNum = 0, pancancerNum = 0,
            programNum = 1, program = "None",
            target = gene_symbol, cellType = "all")
  resp <- tryCatch(httr::GET(encori_api, query = q, httr::timeout(40)),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(resp) || httr::status_code(resp) != 200) return(NULL)
  txt <- httr::content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  tryCatch(readr::read_tsv(txt, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}

encori_curated <- map_dfr(lnc17$lncrna, function(sym) {
  df <- encori_fetch(sym)
  Sys.sleep(0.5)   # educado com a API
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0)
    return(tibble(lncrna = sym, encori_mirna_n = 0L))
  mir_col <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), regex("miRNA", TRUE))][1]
  tibble(lncrna = sym, encori_mirna_n = dplyr::n_distinct(df[[mir_col]]))
})
```

summary and output
```{r}
mirna_summary <- lnc17 %>% dplyr::select(lncrna, enst, ensg) %>%
  left_join(mre_scan,       by = "lncrna") %>%
  left_join(encori_curated, by = "lncrna") %>%
  mutate(encori_mirna_n = coalesce(encori_mirna_n, 0L),
         has_curated_mirna = encori_mirna_n > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(encori_mirna_n), desc(mre_sites_total))

dir.create("R2C2_out", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write_csv(mirna_summary, "R2C2_out/A2_mirna_sponge_summary.csv")
write_csv(mre_detail,    "R2C2_out/A2_mirna_MRE_detail.csv")
saveRDS(list(summary = mirna_summary, mre_detail = mre_detail,
             encori = encori_curated, mirna_panel = mirna_panel),
        "R2C2_out/A2_mirna_sponge.rds")

cat("\n============  miRNA sponge / ceRNA (17 lncRNAs)  ============\n")
print(mirna_summary, n = 30, width = Inf)
cat("\nlncRNAs com interacao miRNA curada (ENCORI): ",
    sum(mirna_summary$has_curated_mirna), " / 17\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
get_seq_by_enst <- function(enst) {
  eb  <- str_remove(enst, "\\.\\d+$")
  idx <- which(hdr$enst_base == eb)
  if (length(idx) == 0) NULL else fa[[idx[1]]]
}
get_seq_by_txname <- function(tx_name) {
  idx <- which(hdr$tx_name == tx_name)
  if (length(idx) == 0) NULL else fa[[idx[1]]]
}

# --- checagem ---
c(lnc17 = exists("lnc17"), seq_set = exists("seq_set"),
  fa = exists("fa"), get_seq_by_enst = exists("get_seq_by_enst"))
```

run
```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("pwalign", quietly = TRUE))
  BiocManager::install("pwalign")
library(pwalign)

submat <- pwalign::nucleotideSubstitutionMatrix(match = 1, mismatch = -1, baseOnly = TRUE)

score_pair <- function(qseq, sseq) {
  if (is.null(qseq) || is.null(sseq)) return(NULL)
  a_s <- pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(qseq, sseq, type = "local",
           substitutionMatrix = submat, gapOpening = 5, gapExtension = 2)
  a_a <- pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(qseq, reverseComplement(sseq), type = "local",
           substitutionMatrix = submat, gapOpening = 5, gapExtension = 2)
  tibble(
    sense_score = pwalign::score(a_s), sense_pid = pwalign::pid(a_s),
    sense_len   = nchar(pwalign::alignedPattern(a_s)),
    anti_score  = pwalign::score(a_a), anti_pid  = pwalign::pid(a_a),
    anti_len    = nchar(pwalign::alignedPattern(a_a))
  )
}

homology_res <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
  qseq <- seq_set[[pairs$lncrna[i]]]
  sseq <- get_seq_by_enst(pairs$target_id[i])
  if (is.null(sseq)) sseq <- get_seq_by_txname(pairs$target_tx[i])
  sc <- score_pair(qseq, sseq)
  if (is.null(sc)) return(NULL)
  bind_cols(tibble(lncrna = pairs$lncrna[i], target = pairs$target_tx[i]), sc)
}) %>%
  mutate(best_score = pmax(sense_score, anti_score),
         best_pid   = if_else(sense_score >= anti_score, sense_pid, anti_pid),
         best_len   = if_else(sense_score >= anti_score, sense_len, anti_len),
         best_dir   = if_else(sense_score >= anti_score, "sense", "antisense"),
         notable    = best_len >= 20 & best_pid >= 80)

homology_summary <- homology_res %>%
  group_by(lncrna) %>%
  summarise(n_targets = n(), n_notable = sum(notable, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_best_len = max(best_len), max_best_pid = round(max(best_pid),1),
            .groups = "drop")

write_csv(homology_res,     "R2C2_out/A3_homology_pairs.csv")
write_csv(homology_summary, "R2C2_out/A3_homology_summary.csv")

homology_res %>%
  filter(notable) %>%
  arrange(desc(best_len)) %>%
  dplyr::select(lncrna, target, best_dir, best_len, best_pid, best_score) %>%
  print(n = 30)

# 1) os dois hits grandes sao repeat de baixa complexidade?
big <- homology_res %>% filter(best_len >= 100)
big %>% dplyr::select(lncrna, target, best_dir, best_len, best_pid)

# 2) DANCR: XACT e LRRK1 estao entre os ALVOS SIGNIFICATIVOS de DANCR?
final_targets %>%
  filter(target_transgene_name == "DANCR") %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_name_trgt_RNA, pearson_r, pearson_padj_BH)

# reconta "notable" com limiar mais rigoroso (>=50 nt), que e o que importa
homology_res %>%
  mutate(notable_strict = best_len >= 50 & best_pid >= 80) %>%
  summarise(n_pairs = n(),
            n_notable_20nt = sum(notable),
            n_notable_50nt = sum(notable_strict))
```

Save the summary
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

orf   <- read_csv("R2C2_out/A1_orf_riboseq_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
mirna <- read_csv("R2C2_out/A2_mirna_sponge_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
homol <- read_csv("R2C2_out/A3_homology_summary.csv",    show_col_types = FALSE)

# --- ORF: presença + nº + classe ---
orf_t <- orf %>%
  transmute(lncrna, enst, ensg,
            orf_n     = gencode_orf_n,
            orf_types = gencode_orf_types,
            orf_exons = if ("gencode_exons" %in% names(orf)) gencode_exons else NA_character_,
            has_orf   = has_translated_orf)

# --- miRNA: curado + intrínseco ---
mirna_t <- mirna %>%
  transmute(lncrna,
            encori_mirna_n,
            mre_sites_total,
            mre_density_per_kb,
            max_sites_one_mirna = if ("max_sites_one_mirna" %in% names(mirna))
                                    max_sites_one_mirna else NA_integer_,
            has_curated_mirna)

# --- homologia: só os 6 ativos têm; resto fica NA/"not tested" ---
homol_t <- homol %>%
  transmute(lncrna,
            homol_targets  = n_targets,
            homol_notable  = n_notable,
            homol_max_len  = max_best_len,
            homol_max_pid  = max_best_pid)

# --- merge nos 17 ---
supp <- orf_t %>%
  left_join(mirna_t, by = "lncrna") %>%
  left_join(homol_t, by = "lncrna") %>%
  mutate(
    active_trans_lncRNA = lncrna %in% c("DANCR","FENDRR","LINC00667",
                                        "LINC00847","LNCPRESS1","PNKY"),
    homology_tested = active_trans_lncRNA,
    across(c(homol_targets, homol_notable, homol_max_len, homol_max_pid),
           ~ if_else(active_trans_lncRNA, ., NA_real_))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(active_trans_lncRNA), lncrna)

write_csv(supp, "R2C2_out/SuppTable_R2C2_mechanisms.csv")
print(supp, width = Inf, n = 30)
```
